@section .gp-columns-2

## Monday

Overcast, light wind from the northwest. A pair of chickadees worked the
suet feeder from sunrise until nearly nine, then vanished for the rest of
the day.

## Tuesday

Clear and cold. First frost of the season on the grass. A lone junco
appeared at the base of the feeder pole, the first sighting this month.

@column-break

## Wednesday

Rain most of the afternoon. Activity at the feeders dropped to almost
nothing, though a wet cardinal sat in the lilac for several minutes
before finally moving on.

@@callout Weather note

Rain days are worth logging even when nothing shows up. A quiet feeder
during a storm is itself a data point, not a blank entry.

@end-section

@page-break

## Thursday

Wind picked up overnight and knocked the smaller feeder loose. Reset it
before dawn; the birds did not seem to mind the interruption.
